title: ReelLoop
tagline: Cozy trophy fishing with crisp haptics.
description: Cast, hook and land trophy fish across unlockable vistas. Manage line tension, upgrade your tackle and fill the trophy room.
controls: Hold to reel, ease off when tension spikes

title: Tap Escape Speedrun
tagline: A pure tap speedrun: escape before time runs out.
description: Every tap pushes the escape meter forward and costs a sliver of time. Clear each sector, earn shards and spend them on strength and efficiency.
controls: Tap the button or press any key

title: EchoKeys
tagline: Musical memory: hear it, play it back.
description: Listen to a growing sequence of notes and repeat it. Ear training that gets harder the better you get.
controls: Enter to start, R to replay

title: EchoKeys ScaleTrainer
tagline: Learn to read music, one note at a time.
description: Identify notes on the staff by sight and sound. Short daily sessions build note recognition fast.

title: Pixel Diner
tagline: Serve, upgrade, and survive the rush.
description: Match orders before customers lose patience. A fast pixel-art cooking sprint.
controls: Tap ingredients to build the order

title: Flappy Bird
description: Tap to flap through the gaps. Deterministic physics, offline play, local best score.
controls: Space / Up to flap, P to pause, R to restart

title: Idle Cyber Defense
description: Build sensors and firewalls that earn threat points while you are away. Coming to Android.
